# Latency-Sensitive Tensor Offloading Plan for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## Executive Summary
To maintain interactive latency on a 12GB GPU while supporting the full Nemotron-H MoE architecture, we must selectively offload tensors that exceed VRAM capacity. The strategy preserves Mamba/attention/router on-GPU while routing shared-expert tensors to CPU RAM, accepting a small throughput penalty for expert computation but keeping critical path latency low.

## 1. Tensor Offloading Strategy

### On-GPU (Critical Path, ~8.5GB)
These tensors must remain on GPU to avoid PCIe bottlenecks during token generation:

| Tensor Name | Shape | Purpose | Size Estimate |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tok_embd` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | Token embedding lookup | ~4.2GB (fp16, 31B vocab) |
| `output_norm` | `{n_embd}` | Final RMSNorm | ~0.2GB |
| `output` / `output_dup` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | LM head | ~4.2GB (duplicated from tok_embd) |
| `attn_norm[i]` | `{n_embd}` | Per-layer attention RMSNorm | ~0.2GB × 80 layers |
| `ssm_in[i]` | `{n_embd, d_in_proj}` | Mamba2 input projection | ~0.8GB × 80 layers |
| `ssm_conv1d[i]` | `{d_conv, d_inner + 2·n_group·d_state}` | Mamba2 convolution | ~0.5GB × 80 layers |
| `ssm_a[i]`, `ssm_d[i]` | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | Mamba2 state matrices | ~0.01GB × 80 layers |
| `ssm_norm[i]` | `{d_inner/n_group, n_group}` | Mamba2 norm | ~0.05GB × 80 layers |
| `ssm_out[i]` | `{d_inner, n_embd}` | Mamba2 output projection | ~0.4GB × 80 layers |
| `wo[i]` | `{n_embd_head_k·n_head_i, n_embd}` | Attention output projection | ~0.5GB ×
